import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    acct_txn = inputs["acct_txn"].copy()
    
    # WHERE amount > 100
    acct_txn = acct_txn[acct_txn["amount"] > 100].copy()
    
    # Add size_band column
    acct_txn["size_band"] = acct_txn["amount"].apply(
        lambda x: "JUMBO" if x >= 1000 else ("LARGE" if x >= 500 else "STANDARD")
    )
    
    # QUALIFY: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_ts DESC, txn_id DESC) = 1
    # This means: for each account_id, keep only the row with the latest txn_ts (descending),
    # and break ties by latest txn_id (descending)
    acct_txn["rn"] = acct_txn.groupby("account_id", sort=False).cumcount()
    acct_txn = acct_txn.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "txn_ts", "txn_id"],
        ascending=[True, False, False],
        kind="stable"
    )
    acct_txn["rn"] = acct_txn.groupby("account_id", sort=False).cumcount()
    acct_txn = acct_txn[acct_txn["rn"] == 0].copy()
    
    # Drop the helper column
    acct_txn = acct_txn.drop(columns=["rn"])
    
    # SELECT: account_id, txn_id, txn_ts, amount, channel, size_band
    result = acct_txn[["account_id", "txn_id", "txn_ts", "amount", "channel", "size_band"]].reset_index(drop=True)
    
    return {"latest_high_value_txn": result}
